method: Deterministic zero-LLM public-site prescreen followed by human/manual shortlist review. No A1-A9 live or paid agents.
interpretation_guardrails: Preliminary score and ESCALATE/SHORTLIST are operational filters, not Opportunity Signals.
commercial_gap_count means configured patterns were not observed in acquired text; it is not proof of absence.
COLLECTION_RESTRICTED is not absence and is not a weak-prospect judgment.
Entity-review access state and prescreen fetch state are separate dated observations.
No outreach, contact submission or paid-agent execution is authorized by this review.

manual_review_findings.score_saturation: 39/50 records reached ESCALATE, including many 100 scores. Generic dental high-value, team and technology language saturates the heuristic; manual selection is mandatory.

selected.rationale: Strong high-value and structure signals with only 2 observed dimensions and 4 pattern gaps; location-specific independent studio.
selected.caveat: Pattern gaps require target-specific confirmation; not a Signal.

selected.rationale: High-value and structure-rich site with 4 pattern gaps and good acquisition depth.
selected.caveat: Generic keyword saturation may inflate the score; inspect first-visit path manually.

selected.rationale: High-value service signals, local independent scope and 3 pattern gaps.
selected.caveat: Public email and VAT ID remain missing.

selected.rationale: Current site acquisition shows high-value content, adequate contactability and 3 pattern gaps.
selected.caveat: Earlier entity pass encountered a verification page; access state is unstable.

selected.rationale: Deep acquisition, high-value and structure signals, plus 3 pattern gaps.
selected.caveat: No VAT ID observed; absence patterns still need protocol confirmation.

selected.rationale: Independent Nervi studio with strong structure, 4 pattern gaps and verified contacts.
selected.caveat: Emergency mobile must not be treated as general outreach permission.

selected.rationale: Local independent scope, 4 pattern gaps, verified contacts and adequate page depth.

selected.caveat: Moderate high-value evidence; comparator fit must be established.

next_gate: Perform free manual first-visit-path review and comparator-fit screening on the 9 selected records. Before any A1-A9 live run, provide per-run scope, agents, activity, sources/data, max EUR budget and stop conditions, then obtain explicit approval.
promotion_rule: No selected record is an Opportunity Signal. Promotion requires target-specific evidence, comparator freeze, Red Team falsification, QA and Human Review.
